newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonia 1996 C/A deficit worsens, BOP steady.
newsitem.headline: Estonia 1996 C/A deficit worsens, BOP steady.

text.p: Estonia's current account deficit in 1996 grew to 5.3 billion kroons in 1996 versus a 2.1 billion kroon deficit in 1995, the central bank said on Monday.
However, the overall balance of payments stayed positive and stable at 1.228 billion kroons versus 1.20 billion kroons in 1995, the central bank added in a statement.

Direct investments into the Estonian economy decreased in 1996 to 1.2 billion kroons from 2.2 billion kroons in 1995, while portfolio investments went from an outflow of 185 million kroons to an inflow of 1.1 billion kroons.
-- David Mardiste, Tallinn newsroom +372 630 8400 reuters@reut ers.ee
